Graduate and Professional Student Resources
Your Future Starts Here
You Have a Vision
Graduate school is an adventure, a journey of curiosity, discovery, and discipline.
And at Nova Southeastern University, we're ready to share that journey with you. The
Office of Graduate and Professional Admissions handles all aspects of graduate and
professional program enrollment and admissions. Move forward with confidence and purpose
with experienced admissions advisers who will support you every step of the way. Achieve
your personal and professional goals in an academic community that's committed to
your success—and make some friends for life along the way.
Apply Now
Request Information
130+ Degree Programs
1 of 3 Universities in the U.S. with Both M.D. and D.O. Colleges
Florida's Largest Private R1 Research University
More Than $100 Million in Scholarships Offered
How to Apply
Each of our colleges and schools offering graduate and professional programs has its
own admissions and financial aid process. Get details about degree programs, including
areas of concentration and degree options. Learn about applying to our graduate and
professional programs, including the specific requirements and deadlines for each
program. Our graduate and professional admission advisers encourage you to contact
them with questions and concerns—or just to explore your options further.
